name: Lumax Industries
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Latest concall: management tone confident / positive
Management outlook: For FY 27, our capex guidance updated to INR 200 to 250 crore, mainly due to new order wins.
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Good (sales +33% YoY, profit +42% YoY)
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 1.7 pts in a year
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 170% of 3-year profit
risks: Margins shrinking (9% to 9%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 50 to 55, inventory days 92 to 90 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: The order book stands at around INR 2,500 crore with LED (Light Emitting Diode) lighting composition of approximately 90%.

Importantly, approximate 90% of our current order book is now LED based, which gives us strong visibility and confidence in further expanding this segment and increasing our market share in the quarters ahead.
guidance: For FY 27, our capex guidance updated to INR 200 to 250 crore, mainly due to new order wins.
And if you look at that, then the margins would be close to about 10.5% to 11% at a total EBITDA level, which is in line with our guidance for FY 27 in the full year.
capex: From a capacity point of view, our Bengaluru plant expansion to support Maruti and Toyota's upcoming models is progressing satisfactorily and is expected to be commissioned from Q4 of FY 27.
For FY 27, our capex guidance updated to INR 200 to 250 crore, mainly due to new order wins.
risks: These statements are not the guarantees of future performance and may involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
Despite these headwinds, FY 27 began on a strong note for the Indian automotive industry with demand remaining resilient across vehicle segments.
focus: This is a result of continued focus on cost discipline, operational efficiencies and growing contribution from our premium product portfolio.
This well- diversified mix underscores our solid positioning across multiple segments of the automotive lighting.
At the same time, we also witnessed healthy business growth from TVS Motors, reflecting focus on customer diversification.

about: Lumax Industries Limited is the flagship company of the DK Jain Group. It was founded as a trading company in 1945 and today it has evolved as market leader of automobile lighting in the Indian automotive industry. In 1984, company entered into a technical collaboration with Stanley Electric Co. Ltd., Japan (SECL), which currently holds around 37.5% equity stake in the company. Other 37.5% is held by Indian promoters
